name: Starter drills
description: Dry fire only: unloaded firearm, magazines empty, no ammunition in the room. Fundamentals (E), skill drills (S) and standards with suggested par times; adjust pars to your level. Many drills are inspired by Ben Stoeger's training books (DryFire Reloaded, Dry-Fire Training: For the Practical Pistol Shooter, Practical Shooting Training); the descriptions are short summaries, so see the books for the full drills.

drills.name: E1 Hold drill
drills.description: Aim at a 1-inch dot on the wall. Hold the sight picture steady for the whole par without disturbing the sights or loosening the grip.

drills.name: E2 Trigger control at speed
drills.description: Gun on target. At the start beep, press the trigger cleanly before the stop beep without disturbing the sights. Shorten the par as you get consistent.

drills.name: E2a Roll pressure
drills.description: Gun on target. Roll steady pressure through the trigger, as you would for a small or distant target, finishing the press within the par.

drills.name: E3 Draw
drills.description: From the holster, draw to a sight picture on target. Do not press the trigger. The par drops each step.

drills.name: E4 Reload
drills.description: Gun on target. At the beep, eject the magazine, seat a fresh one and get back to a sight picture. No trigger press. Work toward about 1 second.

drills.name: E5 Target transition
drills.description: At the beep, draw and get a sight picture on each of several targets in turn. Sight pictures only, no trigger press.

drills.name: E6 Target transition single
drills.description: Gun on one target. At the beep, move to a second target and press one clean shot before the stop beep.

drills.name: Micro 1 Grip
drills.description: Hands relaxed at your sides. At the beep, take a firing grip on the holstered pistol while the support hand moves into position.

drills.name: Micro 2 Draw to aim
drills.description: Start with a firing grip on the holstered pistol and the support hand ready. At the beep, draw and aim at the target.

drills.name: S1 Bill drill
drills.description: 7 yards, one target. Draw and fire six shots. Strong shooters finish in well under 2 seconds.

drills.name: S2 Four aces
drills.description: One target. Draw, fire two, reload, fire two. The par drops each step.

drills.name: S3 El Presidente
drills.description: Three targets, facing up range. At the beep, turn, draw, fire two on each target, reload, and fire two more on each.

drills.name: S3a Vice President
drills.description: El Presidente without the turn: facing the targets, draw, two on each of three targets, reload, two more on each.

drills.name: S3b Half Vice President
drills.description: From low ready, two hits on each of three targets.

drills.name: S3c Blake drill
drills.description: Three targets. Draw and fire two on each (the first half of El Presidente). Expect a par close to your Bill drill.

drills.name: S4 Distance draw
drills.description: At the beep, draw to an A-zone sight picture on a 25-yard target. No trigger press.

drills.name: S4a Distance draw with trigger press
drills.description: As S4, finishing with a clean trigger press.

drills.name: S5 Triple reload
drills.description: Three targets at 7 yards. Six on the first, reload, six on the second, reload, six on the third. Start around 8 to 9 seconds.

drills.name: S6 Near and far
drills.description: Six shots on a near target (about 7 yards), then two on a far target (about 12 yards).

drills.name: S7 Designated target
drills.description: Four targets, one designated. Get a hit on the designated target before each transition to another target.

drills.name: S8 Double Bill
drills.description: 7 yards. A Bill drill, reload, then a second Bill drill. Start around 6 seconds.

drills.name: Distance Standard 1
drills.description: One target at 25 yards. Draw, two shots, reload, two shots. Goals: beginner 5.0 s, intermediate 4.0 s, advanced 3.5 s.

drills.name: Distance Standard 2
drills.description: Draw and fire one shot. Goals: beginner 2.0 s, intermediate 1.5 s, advanced 1.1 s.

drills.name: Distance Standard 3
drills.description: Draw, two shots with both hands, two strong hand only, two weak hand only. Goals: beginner 8.0 s, intermediate 5.2 s, advanced 4.5 s.

drills.name: Distance Standard 4
drills.description: Draw, two shots, reload, two shots, reload, two shots. Goals: beginner 8.0 s, intermediate 5.5 s, advanced 4.5 s.

drills.name: Distance Standard 5
drills.description: Draw and fire six shots. Goals: beginner 3.5 s, intermediate 2.3 s, advanced 2.0 s.

drills.name: FAST
drills.description: 7 yards: draw, two shots on a 3×5 box, reload, four on an 8-inch circle. For dry fire at shorter distance, scale the targets down. Rough levels: under 10 s intermediate, under 7 s advanced, under 5 s expert.

drills.name: Dot torture
drills.description: Par for each string of the dot torture target. Set the reps to the number of strings you shoot.

sets.name: Skill drills
